rules.title: gofmt and go vet
rules.text: Format with gofmt and keep go vet and staticcheck clean.

rules.title: Wrap errors
rules.text: Return errors, wrap them with fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err) and check them with errors.Is and errors.As.

rules.title: Pass context
rules.text: Pass context.Context as the first parameter to functions that do I/O.

rules.title: Small interfaces
rules.text: Define small interfaces at the consumer side; accept interfaces, return structs.

rules.title: Table-driven tests
rules.text: Write table-driven tests with t.Run subtests.

rules.title: Own goroutine lifetimes
rules.text: Never start a goroutine without a clear way for it to stop.
